title: Biomimetic Ion Channel Synthesis Lab
description: The user operates a virtual chemistry lab where they must synthesize a biomimetic ion channel by combining an artificial ion drive mechanism with the nacre-like iridescent shell structure of an abalone. Through a series of calibrated steps—adjusting pH, voltage, temperature, and ion concentration—the user fuses the two structures into a functional bio-hybrid membrane, observing real-time visual feedback as the materials merge at the molecular level.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Biomimetic Ion Channel Synthesis Lab. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb and place it on the left side of the scene representing an artificial ion propulsion core. Load IridescenceAbalone.glb and place it on the right representing a biological nacre template. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) with OrbitControls. Add a warm DirectionalLight, a cool HemisphereLight, and a subtle PointLight near each model. Create an HTML overlay control panel with these interactive steps requiring parameter validation: (1) a pH slider (range 2.0–12.0) that must be set between 6.8–7.4 to activate step 2, turning the abalone shell green-tinted via emissive color; (2) a voltage dial (0–500mV) that must be set to 180–220mV, causing the ion drive to glow and slowly rotate; (3) a temperature input (0–200°C) validated to 36–38°C, triggering particle effects (use Points geometry) streaming between the two models; (4) an ion concentration dropdown (Na+, K+, Ca2+) where selecting Ca2+ is correct, changing particle color to blue; (5) a 'Begin Fusion' button enabled only when all four parameters are valid, which animates both models translating toward center over 2 seconds using TWEEN or requestAnimationFrame lerping; (6) once merged at center, the combined object should slowly rotate with an iridescent pulsing effect by oscillating emissive intensity on both models using a sine wave over time. Display a status bar showing completion percentage across all steps. If any parameter is set outside valid range, show a red warning label next to that control. On successful fusion, display a congratulatory banner reading 'Bio-Hybrid Ion Channel Synthesized' with a subtle CSS animation. Ensure both GLB models are visible and integral throughout the entire interaction.
